messages.content:
Risk: Sensitive Information Disclosure
Description: Sensitive information can affect both the LLM and its application context. This includes personal identifiable information (PII), financial details, health records, confidential business data, security credentials, and legal documents. Proprietary models may also have unique training methods and source code considered sensitive, especially in closed or foundation models.
Concern: None
Policy: Proprietary Technical Data

Candidate ontology classes:
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/LOAN/LoansGeneral/LoansRegulatory/InformationRight: information right — The right to some information in some context, for example when purchasing some product. The right to full and fair disclosure of [found by 12/20 queries]
  Siblings: equal treatment right
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/RegulatoryAgencies/RegulatoryReport: regulatory report — document required to support operational transparency that demonstrates compliance with some specification, law, policy, restriction, or other rule specified by a regulatory agency [found by 13/20 queries]
  Siblings: technical specification document, registry, transaction record
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/ContextualIdentifiers/ContextualIdentificationScheme: contextual identification scheme — identification scheme that applies within one or more contexts [found by 13/20 queries]
  Siblings: driver's license identification scheme, tax identification scheme, national identification number scheme
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#FinancialDataExposure: Financial Data Exposure — Disclosure of personal financial information including account numbers, credit scores, or transaction histories without authorization. [found by 12/20 queries]
  Siblings: Unauthorized Surveillance, Health Data Exposure, Direct Identifier Exposure
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/Documents/Notice: notice — announcement, communication, intimation, or advance warning of something, usually, but not necessarily, to allow preparations to be made [found by 12/20 queries]
  Siblings: indication of interest, publication, reference document
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/ContextualDesignators/Context: context — situation or frame of reference in which something applies, exists, happens, or is used and that helps to illustrate or explain it [from restriction: isApplicableIn on ContextualIdentificationScheme]

axes.rationale: This class directly relates to the disclosure of sensitive information, specifically financial data, which is a key aspect of the risk described.
The context in which sensitive information is disclosed is crucial for understanding the risk, as it defines the situation or frame of reference where the disclosure occurs.
